full_score: abs(beta_j)*sqrt((K a_j).T H (K a_j)), K=(H+alpha I)^-1
floor_rule: LN_floor and FULL_OPT use exact lower-bound constrained allocation max(epsilon/p,tau*score); NORM/LEV use (1-epsilon)*normalized_score+epsilon/p
target: full-data Ridge beta=X.T solve(H+alpha I,y), identical for all five rules
estimator: X.T solve(Mhat+alpha I,y); weighted sampling with replacement; full X recovery; direct SPD solve

primary.unit: independent data-set mean over 40 paired sketches; 40 units
primary.test: two-sided paired Student t, alpha .05; one primary contrast
primary.interval: two-sided t39 95% confidence interval for mean paired difference
primary.secondary: other rules/budgets and pointwise curve intervals are descriptive, without simultaneous coverage claims

sampling: fresh SeedSequence([sampling_seed,data_id,budget,1]); common uniforms across five rules; budgets have distinct streams
input_reuse: all 40 stored Experiment I main-arm inputs; reuse-data ablation, not independent data confirmation
outputs: untrimmed squared target gap, relative gap, unique atoms, first-order coefficient criterion, inner surrogate, calibration, tail diagnostics, paired primary inference
boundaries: Oracle-score comparison only; no NOPL, outer iteration, new data screening, formal-result tuning or speedup claim. Preserve ties, reversals, extremes and failures. Zero-target relative gaps are undefined.
release_gate: predecessor stable-V version experiment-V-support-stable-20261031-v1; completed status/results; passed support_gate and independent_validation; completed old/new report; no dependence on OPT ranking
